# AI Film Master Guide

The master guide to professional AI filmmaking: Higgsfield mastery, pro craft,
animated and photorealistic tracks, competition-entry craft. Static site + API.
Private research repo. Full text: `llms-full.txt`.

## Guide (human-readable site)

Generated static site in `site/` — rebuild with `python3 scripts/build_site.py`
after editing chapters. Open `site/index.html`.

- `site/index.html` — landing: track picker (animated vs photorealistic), chapter grid, learning paths
- `site/<section>/<chapter>.html` — 21 chapters with sidebar nav, table of contents, prev/next
- `site/api.html` — human-readable API docs
- `site/skills.html` — browsable skills library with live filter
- `site/budget.html` — interactive credit-budget calculator
- `site/workshop.html` — interactive prompt workshop (template × model × track, save/rate)
- `site/quiz.html` — model-picker quiz: 5 questions → ranked top-3 from `models.json` with cost math, one-click handoff to the workshop
- `site/changelog.html` — dated changelog rebuilt from git history
- `site/skill-spec.html` — the skill frontmatter+sections format as a spec
- `site/search-index.json` — client-side search index (Ctrl+K palette)

Interactive in-context glossary: `assets/js/glossary.js` wraps the 79 `glossary.json` terms in chapter prose (first occurrence per page) with hover/focus/tap popover definitions.

Chapters (source Markdown, also the canonical text):
- `higgsfield/` — platform-mastery, prompt-engineering, soul-id-deep-dive, competition-entry-craft
- `craft/` — story-structure, cinematic-language, character-consistency, directing-performance, color-grading, sound-music-audio, editing-pipeline, long-form-pipeline, failure-gallery
- `distribution/` — release-paths
- `legal/` — rights-and-disclosure
- `platforms/` — field-guide, when-to-use-what
- `economics/` — credit-math
- `case-studies/` — competition-teardowns, entry-craft-teardowns
- `sources/` — source-index

Note: competitions are covered only as craft teachers (constraints, judging
criteria, delivery discipline). No prizes, deadlines, or promotional material.

## API (static JSON, versioned)

Base: `api/v1/` — rebuild with `python3 scripts/build_api.py` (reads the
research artifacts; outputs committed).

- `api/v1/index.json` — manifest: version, endpoints, observation date, provenance
- `api/v1/models.json` — 18 models: platform, type, credit costs, strengths, weaknesses, best use; explicit `unverified` list
- `api/v1/prompt-templates.json` — 31 templates: 15 core (`t1`–`t15`), 8 animated (`a1`–`a8`), 8 photorealistic (`p1`–`p8`); anatomy, use, models
- `api/v1/camera-movements.json` — 22-move camera lexicon with prompt phrasing and use cases
- `api/v1/checklists.json` — pre-production, per-shot, continuity, audio, delivery checklists
- `api/v1/glossary.json` — 79 AI film / production terms
- `api/v1/competitions.json` — judged competitions as craft records: what they judge, production constraints, craft lessons; no prizes or deadlines
- `api/v1/schema/` — JSON Schema (draft-07) for models, prompt templates, camera movements, competitions

## Skills (agentic task procedures)

191 skills in `skills/` — rebuild with `python3 scripts/build_skills.py`
(generates from `api/v1/` data + authored procedures; outputs committed).
`skills/index.json` is the manifest: id, title, description, path per skill.

For agents: load the skill whose task matches the request — skills are the
primary interface for *doing* work; the JSON endpoints are the data layer.
`api/v1/index.json` points here (`repository`, `skills`, `for_agents`).

Categories: prompts (31), camera (22), models (18), checklists (5),
longform (12), techniques (7), craft (20), entry (4), workflow (8),
compare (10), fix (6), budget (3), delivery (3), audio (4), recipes (12),
styles (8), performance (9), grading (3), distribution (2), legal (4).

## Key facts agents should know

- Higgsfield pricing (read live 2026-10-10): Starter $19/mo annual = 270 credits;
  Plus $47/mo annual = 1,200; Ultra $99/mo annual = 3,000. Verify live before budgeting.
- Credit costs in `models.json` are Higgsfield credits per 5s unless noted.
- Long-form rule: 5–20× generation overhead; assets before shots; registry as production database.

## Known limitations

- Some per-model costs unverified (Seedance 2.5, Soul Cinema, Luma/Pika on
  Higgsfield) — listed in `models.json` → `unverified`.
